Yes — that's clear and I trust it. "Natural" on its own gave me two, but once I set "Within a label" to architecture, it kept only the architecture one that also had "natural" — so it's honestly combining the two conditions, my typed word *and* the label, rather than ignoring one. And the "Within: architecture" reminder sitting there is important to me: it tells me plainly why I'm seeing a smaller set, so I won't panic that links have gone missing — I can see I've deliberately narrowed to one label. That little label of what's active is exactly what makes it trustworthy. Searching within a label works just as I hoped.

I know you had a second version of the deeper search to compare — happy to glance at that before I settle on which control I prefer.
